Description.en-US: Adds a Repair submenu to the game's own Q context menu, so you pick which module to fix instead of repairing everything at once: engine, transmission, radiator, left track or right track. Each module has its own countdown - all five together take 30 seconds - and the remaining time is shown at the bottom of the screen. Pressing Q again cancels the job and keeps whatever was already repaired.
Description.zh-CN: 在游戏原生的 Q 菜单里加一个 Repair 子菜单，点哪个模块修哪个，而不是一键全修：发动机、变速箱、散热器、左履带、右履带。每个模块各自读条，五个全修完正好 30 秒，读条期间屏幕底部显示剩余时间。再按一次 Q 取消，已经修好的部分保留。

Description.en-US: Once 3 or more wrecks are sitting on the field, every wreck that has been burning for 8 seconds is cleared away, so a long battle stops losing frames to vehicles nobody is driving. Nothing happens below that count, F8 turns it off mid-mission, and the wrecks are shown again while the after action replay runs.
Description.zh-CN: 场上堆了 3 辆以上残骸后，烧了 8 秒以上的那些会被收走，免得长时间作战一直为没人开的空车掉帧。不到这个数它什么都不做，F8 可以随时关掉，战后回放期间残骸会重新显示。
